reason: 该插件的核心是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供“手机端语音通话”入口：通过二维码配对后在移动浏览器中接入现有会话，并利用桌面端转写与合成能力完成对话音频化。依据说明与清单可确认其主要是桌面与移动端语音交互桥接类工具，带有网络与音频处理能力。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于将现有 DeepSeek Harness 会话扩展为手机网页语音通话模式，扫码配对后可通过麦克风与会话进行听说交互，并在手机端播放语音回复。
summaries.en: This plugin extends an existing DeepSeek Harness session into a mobile web voice-call flow, letting users pair by QR code and interact by speaking with replies played back as synthesized audio.

capabilities: session pairing via QR code and URL fragment

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a mobile voice-call add-on for existing DSH sessions, using a scanned QR to enter a narrowed mobile web page and start calls, with no standalone APK.

README details the call flow: phone browser records audio, desktop performs local whisper.cpp transcription, and replies are synthesized and sent back for playback on phone, with Cloudflare Quick Tunnel used for HTTPS access.
package.json marks it as a DSH plugin with bundle patch metadata and includes dependencies for proxy and QR-code handling, confirming plugin integration and web bridge/network functionality.

capabilities: session pairing via QR code and URL fragment
